body.heading: Where in the world is Costa Rica?
paragraphs: Costa Rica is a country in Central America, which is part of North America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Costa Rica is San José.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Costa Rica is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Costa Rica is the Costa Rican colón.

body.heading: How big is Costa Rica?
paragraphs: Costa Rica covers about 51,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Guatemala.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Arenal's perfect cone watches over hot springs, hanging bridges in the rainforest canopy and the La Fortuna waterfall's swimming pool.
Manuel Antonio packs beaches and jungle into one small park — monkeys, sloths and iguanas along trails that end at white-sand coves.

body.heading: Think and talk
